title: Protected Relay download-edge runtime secret bundle
description: Secret-bearing schema for the isolated download-edge process. This schema deliberately contains no example secret values.

allOf.$comment: Exactly one 32-byte Ed25519 seed; do not store or supply a 64-byte private key.

$comment: The Go parser checks both canonical text and decoded binary representations, rejects placeholders/development values/low diversity, and requires all five text secrets plus all three encoded and decoded key representations to be pairwise independent.

secret32.$comment: The runtime parser additionally rejects surrounding whitespace, C0/DEL controls, placeholders and low diversity.

canonical_base64_32.$comment: Canonical padded RFC 4648 Base64 encoding of exactly 32 bytes; decoded bytes must also contain at least eight distinct byte values.
